episodes.name: Time for Change
episodes.overview: Twelve people who want to get healthy and transform their lives arrive at The Biggest Loser Campus.

episodes.name: A Big Loss
episodes.overview: A loss by one team causes emotions to run high as the contestants push harder to meet their goals.

episodes.name: Supporting the Team
episodes.overview: Two contestants overcome their insecurities and emerge as leaders during this week's challenge.

episodes.name: Messages from Home
episodes.overview: All the remaining contestants finally get to reconnect with friends and family.

episodes.name: Diving In
episodes.overview: The contestants take a dive into fitness as friendships grow stronger.

episodes.name: Overcoming Obstacles
episodes.overview: One contestant faces an unexpected obstacle, forcing their team to come together in new ways.

episodes.name: Going Solo
episodes.overview: It’s every person for themselves as the contestants no longer compete in teams.

episodes.name: Boosting Morale
episodes.overview: The contestants get the encouragement they need to keep moving forward on their journey.

episodes.name: Final Four
episodes.overview: The final four contestants revisit a fitness milestone to see how much progress they have made.
